narration: In month {fork_month}, after {identical_months} months that matched exactly, an unasked-for card arrived and you chose {real_choice}. The ghost chose {ghost_choice}. {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, that same month, and the ghost's money ran above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months from then on. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the widest point of the whole run, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}. Against a stretch with no pay, the ghost's cushion ended {safety_gap}.
